label: MRtrix3 dcminfo
description:
Output DICOM fields in human-readable format

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

parameters.label: all
parameters.usage: print all DICOM fields. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: csa
parameters.description: print all Siemens CSA fields (excluding Phoenix unless requested)
parameters.usage: print all Siemens CSA fields (excluding Phoenix unless requested) Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: phoenix
parameters.usage: print Siemens Phoenix protocol information Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

input_slots.label: file
input_slots.description: the DICOM file to be scanned.

output_slots.label: report
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory. Output DICOM fields in human-readable format
